facts.text: Available from Business Central 2022 release wave 2 (version 21) and later
Configuration is stored in CustomSettings.config file located at the service directory
Use Set-NAVServerConfiguration cmdlet to change settings with ServerInstance, KeyName, and KeyValue parameters
Restart the server instance using Services console or Restart-NAVServerInstance cmdlet for changes to take effect
Dynamically updatable settings can use ApplyTo parameter with options: ConfigFile, Memory, or All
Changes applied to Memory take effect immediately without restart but revert on server restart
Direct editing of CustomSettings.config is not recommended due to risk of typing errors
